items.quote: It outlines appropriate and fair processes for handling complaints of sexual violence or misconduct.
items.reason: The policy is a dedicated sexual misconduct policy with its own processes for handling complaints.
The policy does not commit to being publicly posted or available.

items.quote: A student who has experienced sexual misconduct can make a complaint to the College’s Director of Student Services (see below), or any employee of the College with whom the student feels comfortable.
items.reason: The policy provides clear, concrete steps and contact details for reporting to the Director of Student Services.
The policy does not address the complainant's past sexual history.
The policy does not address protection from face-to-face contact.
The policy requires everyone involved to maintain confidentiality during the process.

items.quote: This policy does not replace the criminal process. Any individual who is a survivor of sexual misconduct or who witnesses criminal behaviour is encouraged to report that behaviour to the RCMP.
items.reason: The policy mentions the criminal process as an option but does not explicitly state the survivor has the right to choose.
The policy does not address amnesty for drug or alcohol use when reporting.

items.quote: Where the Director receives an actionable complaint, they will initiate an investigation within five business days.
items.reason: The policy sets a timeline to initiate the investigation but lacks a binding timeline for completing the overall process.

items.quote: At any time before or during an investigation, the College may take interim measures to ensure the well-being of any member of the College.
items.reason: The policy states that the College may take interim measures, making them discretionary.

items.quote: This policy applies to sexual misconduct involving a student of the College, both on and off campus, that is in any way related to the student being a member of the College community
items.reason: Off-campus activities are covered generally, but co-op, internships, or work placements are not explicitly mentioned.

items.quote: If the outcome of the investigation is that the allegation of sexual misconduct is unsubstantiated, the College will promptly notify the individuals involved.
items.reason: The policy commits to notifying the individuals involved if the allegation is unsubstantiated, but does not explicitly guarantee informing the survivor of the specific outcome or sanctions if substantiated.
The policy does not mention public annual reporting of sexual violence statistics.

items.section: Policy, Section: Related policies and references
items.reason: The policy indicates a scheduled review date but does not explicitly state a binding review interval.
The policy does not address student representation on the policy review committee.
The policy does not require trauma-informed training for investigators or decision-makers.

items.quote: NLC will build a culture of consent by offering ongoing education, awareness and training to the members of the college community about prevention and response to sexual misconduct.
items.reason: The policy commits to offering ongoing education, awareness, and training to the college community.
